snapshot.title: List view
snapshot.description:
The main GUI screen, using the generated `connect-es` client in `web/src/gen`.

- Projects, each with its features in rank order, each expandable to its tasks in rank order.
- Per item: title, effective status, blocked indicator, claim (agent and expiry), draft badge.
- Live updates through WatchItems.
- Item detail panel: description (markdown), dependencies, work state (branch, PR, progress), revision.
